Theorem
[Splitting and diameter bounds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0428 ↗ def:chow-iii-g35-g36-aleksandrov 1. appG:G.45–G.46\group Aleksandrov structure

An Aleksandrov space of nonnegative curvature containing a line is isometric to $Y\times \R $ for an Aleksandrov space $Y$ of nonnegative curvature. If its curvature is at least $k>0$, then $\diam X\leq \pi /\sqrt{k}$.
